run_smc_sampler: run the Sequential Monte Carlo sampler algorithm using outer_loop_smc with a density function, initial sampler, and Markov kernel
run_fast_smc_evaluation: run the fast SMC loop using fast_outer_loop_smc for evaluation or embedding inside other algorithms with jax.lax.scan
review_inner_loop_reweight_resample: review the inner_loop function that reweights samples, optionally resamples, and applies a Markov transition kernel
build_curried_inner_loop: build a curried short inner loop using get_short_inner_loop to prepare for JIT compilation or lax.scan
refactor_smc_resampling_threshold: refactor the SMC inner loop to adjust the resample_threshold and use_resampling config flags for better particle diversity
